text.en: Swin Transformer V2 is row 1 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: Swin Transformer V2 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 1 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates Swin Transformer V2 with “Swin Transformer V2: Scaling Up Capacity and Resolution”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Swin Transformer V2 与论文《Swin Transformer V2: Scaling Up Capacity and Resolution》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Ze Liu, Han Hu”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 刘泽、胡瀚；官方英文原文为“Ze Liu, Han Hu”。

text.en: Ze Liu and Han Hu, the two main contributors named by BenchCouncil, are both authors of the CVPR 2022 paper; their researcher-controlled homepages independently identify the same people and work.
text.zh: BenchCouncil 列出的两位主要人物刘泽和胡瀚均为 CVPR 2022 论文作者；两人的个人学术主页也分别确认了同一人物与成果。

text.en: Swin Transformer V2 combines residual post-normalization and scaled cosine attention for stability, log-spaced continuous position bias for resolution transfer, and SimMIM pretraining to reduce labeled-data demand.
text.zh: Swin Transformer V2 使用残差后归一化与缩放余弦注意力提升稳定性，以对数间隔连续位置偏置支持分辨率迁移，并用 SimMIM 预训练降低对标注数据的需求。

text.en: The paper reports a 3-billion-parameter model, inputs up to 1536 x 1536, and results across ImageNet-V2, COCO, ADE20K and Kinetics-400.
text.zh: 论文报告了 30 亿参数模型、最高 1536 x 1536 的输入分辨率，以及在 ImageNet-V2、COCO、ADE20K 和 Kinetics-400 上的结果。
